ValidationRule.description: Signature Verifier Team Cannot Change the result until Credit Approver Approves.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c, 'Approve')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), AND(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card"), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Credit_Card' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Signature Verifier cannot change the result until Credit Approval Approves.
